step.cmd: In the Name field under Basic Information, enter a descriptive name for the sync, for example Salesforce Knowledge Sync.
Under Source & Target, select an adapter from the Heretto Deploy Adapter list.
step.info: The adapter defines the source system the sync reads content from. Heretto Deploy is currently the only supported adapter.

step.cmd: Select a connector from the Target Connector list.
step.info: The connector defines the target system the sync publishes content to, for example Salesforce Knowledge.

step.cmd: Under Source — Heretto Deploy, enter the Deployment ID for the content in Heretto in the Deployment ID field.
step.info: The Deployment ID is a UUID that identifies the specific deployment in Heretto Deploy from which content will be read. You can find it in your Heretto Deploy deployment settings.

step.cmd: Under Target Connection, select a saved credential from the credential list.

info.p: If no credential exists yet, click New credential to expand the inline credential form. Enter the required values for your target connector and click Save Credential. The new credential will be selected automatically.

step.cmd: Under Schedule, configure how often the sync runs automatically.

chrow.chdesc: Leave the Manual sync only — no automatic schedule checkbox unchecked and use the schedule builder to set a recurring schedule, such as daily at 9 AM.
Select Manual sync only — no automatic schedule to disable automatic runs. The sync will run only when you trigger it manually from the Sync Detail page.

step.cmd: Under Field Mapping, map each Heretto source field you want to publish to its corresponding field API name in the target system.

substep.cmd: Click Add Field to add a mapping row.
In the left dropdown, select a source field from Heretto Deploy.
In the right input, enter the API name of the target field in your connector, for example Answer__c.
Repeat for each field you want to map.

step.info: See for the list of available source fields and format details.

step.cmd: Optional: Under Data Category Mapping, map Heretto taxonomy group names to Salesforce data category group API names.

substep.cmd: Click Add Category to add a mapping row.
In the left field, enter the name of the Heretto taxonomy group, for example Audiences.
In the right dropdown, select the corresponding Salesforce data category group. The list is populated from your Salesforce organization.
Repeat for each taxonomy group you want to map.

step.info: This section appears only when the target connector is Salesforce. Data category groups must exist in Salesforce Setup before they appear in the dropdown. See for format details.
